proof_body:
by
  intro ζ n hn h
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have e : ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (m + 1), (1 - ζ ^ k) = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_Ico_eq_prod_range]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, add_comm 1]
    have := h.prod_one_sub_pow_eq_order
    push_cast
    exact this
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  rw [← norm_prod, e, Complex.norm_natCast]
target_source: ∀ (ζ : ℂ) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n → ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, (1 - ζ ^ k) = n ∧ ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, ‖1 - ζ ^ k‖ = n
